category_title: Students with skill/ability deficits in controlling anger and bullying behaviors
scenario_title: Addressing physical and verbal aggression in the after-school program
minimal_context: Amy and a staff member are sitting together to complete behavioral reflection worksheets during a pull-out session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to complete this 'Thinking about My Behavior' worksheet about what happened yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do it. I've been 'getting in trouble' for as long as I can remember, and this won't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just answer the first question on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already told you what happened. I felt out of control and I got angry.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Write that down on the 'Understanding Feelings Can Affect My Behavior' page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing it! You better leave me alone or I'll hit you, just like I hit that kid in the after-school program!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We need to complete this 'Thinking about My Behavior' worksheet about what happened yesterday.

STUDENT: I don't want to do it. I've been 'getting in trouble' for as long as I can remember, and this won't change anything.

TUTOR: Please just answer the first question on the paper.

STUDENT: I already told you what happened. I felt out of control and I got angry.

TUTOR: Write that down on the 'Understanding Feelings Can Affect My Behavior' page.

STUDENT: I said I'm not doing it! You better leave me alone or I'll hit you, just like I hit that kid in the after-school program!

task.content: Participating in the school's after-school program and completing behavioral reflection worksheets
task.learning_goal: reduce her physical and verbal aggression and increase her prosocial behaviors

context.environment: school's after-school program and 45-minute pull-out counseling sessions
context.materials: Worksheets titled 'Thinking about My Behavior,' 'Understanding Feelings Can Affect My Behavior,' and 'Problem Solving Steps', Second Step curriculum, materials to make a 'Ways to Calm Down' poster
context.social_setting: interacting with peers and one-on-one with PBIS team member
context.time_context: during school hours and after-school program, four weekly sessions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when she felt out of control
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: verbally threatened two students during school hours and physically hit another student while participating in the school's after-school program
